Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

darkniche 0.1.0

First release.

Environmental space and metrics

  • dn_space(), dn_density(), dn_centres(), dn_moments() — one shared lattice for every object; fixed-bandwidth kernel densities reproducing scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter to within 2e-7.
  • dn_envelope(), dn_entryq(), dn_weights() — q-envelopes, cumulative density rank, and the weight vectors behind each coverage statistic.
  • dn_metrics() — the directional family (DNC_q, DNC_auc, NSI_q, NSI_min, DNC_min, CFI, CFI_w, NOV) with Schoener’s D, Warren’s I and the Bhattacharyya coefficient computed alongside for comparison.

Null models

  • dn_null_breadth() (N1), dn_null_shift() (N2, reproducible via injectable shift targets), dn_null_relocate() (N3).
  • dn_ses(), dn_null_summary() — standardised effect sizes with a floored null standard deviation.

Calibration, accounting and inference

  • dn_match(), dn_auc(), dn_delong(), dn_calibrate() — realm- and area-matched negatives, fast DeLong AUC and paired tests, Youden calibration.
  • dn_dark(), dn_cddr(), dn_report() — conjunction rule, area-adjusted dark-diversity ratio, one-call region report.
  • dn_aggregate() — Poisson-binomial region-level test with expected >= 5 reliability suppression.
  • dn_sweep(), dn_direction_census() — the threshold-sweep diagnostic with reversal detection in print and plot.

Reporting and data

  • Seven plotting functions and two table exporters (CSV, Markdown, LaTeX).
  • dn_data() — published results for all 619 WWF terrestrial ecoregions.

Quality

  • 169 unit tests: 56 golden assertions against an independent Python reference implementation (tools/make_golden.py regenerates the fixtures), 113 behavioural.
  • R CMD check clean; CI on Linux, Windows and macOS.
  • analysis/ regenerates every figure and table of the software paper.

Installation notes

R does not install a package’s tests by default. To run the suite from an installed copy:

remotes::install_github("ehsanrahimi666/darkniche",
                        INSTALL_opts = "--install-tests")
testthat::test_package("darkniche")

Distribution

Installed from GitHub with remotes::install_github("ehsanrahimi666/darkniche"). Not submitted to CRAN: the existing CRAN package DarkDiv estimates dark diversity from co-occurrence data, and a near-name collision would confuse users of both. Documentation is published to GitHub Pages by CI.

Roadmap (0.2.0)

  • Compiled backends for dn_density() and dn_metrics(), validated by the existing golden tests.
  • Three-dimensional environmental space behind the same interface.
  • Tail-refined permutation p-values.
  • A GLM establishment-model helper closing the calibration loop in R.
  • Further pkgdown articles (a full worked reanalysis).
